errors.text_span: "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" in pink, and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" in a darker shade of pink
errors.evidence: The legend and bars show that "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" is represented by a purple color, not pink. The color for "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" is a solid peach/light red, not a darker shade of pink.

errors.text_span: The "no SFT" bar for LLAMA-2-7B has an approximate value of 6
errors.evidence: The bar for "no SFT" for the LLAMA-2-7B model is clearly below 5, at approximately 4. A value of 6 is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bar for LLAMA-2-70B has an approximate value of 27
errors.evidence: The bar for "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" for the LLAMA-2-70B model is the tallest bar on the chart, reaching approximately 50.5%. The value 27 is incorrect and is closer to the value for the "no SFT" bar in that same group (approx. 26%).

The description fails to mention the distinct patterns on the bars (diagonal stripes, horizontal stripes) which are used along with color to differentiate the series. It only mentions color differentiation.
